page: Microsoft Azure E20ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 20 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 10 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache per core. It is equipped with 160.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The server includes 1181 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring 3080.48 and Geekbench single-core reaching 2105.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 30802.17 and a PassMark CPU score of 32617.89, both falling in the middle 50% tier. Memory subsystem performance is notable, with PassMark memory scoring in the top 25% at 2775.61, while large-block memory read and write bandwidths remain average at 76.66 GB/sec and 55.94 GB/sec respectively. Large-model LLM inference is a bottleneck, with the 70B model prompt processing scoring in the bottom 25% at 5.46 tokens/sec, whereas small-model text generation reaches top-tier speeds of 331.24 tokens/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the E20ads_v6 offers high memory capacity and substantial local NVMe storage relative to its vCPU count, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive multi-core scaling. The inclusion of 1181 GB of local storage reduces the immediate need for external disk attachments for temporary data. This configuration is suited for database operations, memory-intensive web serving, medium-scale text processing, and small-model language inference tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure E20ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 20 dedicated vCPUs and 160.0 GB of RAM. It features 1181 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, with no integrated GPU. Benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU performance and strong memory performance, while multi-core metrics and large-block memory bandwidth remain in the average tier. LLM inference on small models is highly efficient, reaching top-tier text generation speeds, though large-model performance is weak. This server is suited for memory-intensive databases, text processing, and caching layers.
